lines.t: How is it you have yet to consider, to see with greater eyes?
let go of your preconceived notions and biased beliefs,
put away all your self-serving expectations,
that your understanding may be set free.
from the foundation of the world even to this day,
consider the vastness of My Glory and offer up perfect praise!
And so I have spoken this one phrase in your hearing,
Yet not one has truly discerned,
not one among you has truly considered the scope of its meaning.
For the whole of Scripture speaks to one end,
the glory of The Holy One,
He who is and was and is to come.
And as the glory of The Messiah is fulfilled in this:
even the whole of The Scriptures in One,
so in like manner have I revealed it to you, once again.
For the fulfillment of all things
Has come, and is revealed in this:
The One who was has come;
The One who is, is come,
The One who is to come,
is coming quickly to fulfill and complete.
And His name is The Great I AM,
